artifact_observations.location: Red retention straps/bands in the lower center
artifact_observations.reasoning: The red bands meant to hold the tools exhibit impossible physics. They loop through solid tool handles without clear entry/exit points, merge into the background, and have inconsistent thickness. Some loops appear to float or connect to nothing, indicating a failure in logical structural connectivity.

artifact_observations.location: Junctions between red straps and tool handles
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundaries where the red straps overlap the black tool handles are blurry and indistinct. The materials seem to bleed into each other rather than sitting on top, suggesting a generation artifact in object interaction.
The metallic reflection on the hammer is overly smooth and lacks the micro-scratches or wear expected on a used tool. The transition from the head to the shaft is slightly soft.
